name: Polymarket BTC displayed prediction liquidity
description: Displayed native-token book liquidity for one bound Polymarket market generation. It publishes both outcome spreads and top sizes, total displayed bid/ask depth, and the exact book-only cost/proceeds for a research-initial ten-outcome-unit probe. The probe excludes fees and is a measurement normalization, not an order recommendation; output fails closed if either native book cannot fill it. No cross-market book state survives a market_transition boundary. While the venue is alive — any book, quote, trade, or contract input admitted within staleness_bound_ms (10000 ms) — an unchanged resting book republishes its band-depth values and stays ready, while a genuinely silent venue and every integrity fault (snapshot missing, one-sided, crossed or invalid, insufficient probe depth) still degrade unchanged. Book age uses monotonic receipt time. Decimal values are rounded to at most eight places using round-half-to-even.
